# Environment

These variables change Ensemble's local behavior. None of them sends data off the machine and none is required for a normal install.

## Product variables

| Variable | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `ENSEMBLE_LOG` | on | `0` disables file and ring logging. Any other value keeps logging on. |
| `ENSEMBLE_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | Minimum level: `error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug`, or `trace`. An invalid value falls back to `info`. |
| `ENSEMBLE_LOG_DIR` | `$XDG_STATE_HOME/ensemble/logs` | Log sink directory. When `XDG_STATE_HOME` is unset, the default is `~/.local/state/ensemble/logs`. |
| `ENSEMBLE_LOG_CONTENT` | off | `1` includes task and message text in logs. Privacy-sensitive; leave unset unless you need the text. |
| `ENSEMBLE_LOG_STDERR` | off | `1` mirrors log lines to stderr. |
| `ENSEMBLE_DEBUG_CLONES` | off | `1` exposes full-clone counts and timing on the diagnostic RPC. |
| `ENSEMBLE_REDUCED_MOTION` | off | `1` or `true` freezes decorative motion. |
| `ENSEMBLE_ASCII` | off | `1` or `true` uses ASCII chrome separators and marks. `TERM=dumb` has the same effect. |
| `NO_COLOR` | unset | Presence of any value, including the empty string, suppresses color and also enables reduced motion. |
| `TERM` | inherited | `dumb` selects the ASCII chrome fallback. Other values are owned by the terminal. |
| `XDG_STATE_HOME` | `~/.local/state` | Base for Ensemble logs and the OpenCode service descriptor. Ensemble does not read `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `XDG_DATA_HOME`, or `XDG_CACHE_HOME` for its own state. |
| `OPENCODE_PASSWORD` | service descriptor password | Basic-auth password for the service RPCs used by doctor, data, backup, and the support bundle. It takes precedence over the descriptor password. |

## State paths

| Path | Owner | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `$XDG_STATE_HOME/ensemble/logs` | Ensemble | Default log directory, or `ENSEMBLE_LOG_DIR`. Files are owner-only in an owner-only directory; default retention is 7 days, 5 rotated files per role/prefix, and 10 MiB per file. |
| `$XDG_STATE_HOME/opencode/service.json` | OpenCode | Service descriptor read by the operator CLIs. `--service-file` overrides the path; `--server` overrides the URL. |
| `~/.local/state` | OpenCode and Ensemble | Fallback base when `XDG_STATE_HOME` is unset. |

`XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `XDG_DATA_HOME`, and `XDG_CACHE_HOME` are set by the live test harness. Ensemble does not use them for its own state, so do not document them as product configuration.

## Support bundle redaction

The support bundle removes the values of `OPENCODE_PASSWORD`, `GITHUB_TOKEN`, and `NPM_TOKEN` from every collected file. The last two are redaction inputs, not Ensemble configuration. There is no telemetry upload.

## Test-harness variables

These variables belong to the repository's live, fake, benchmark, and soak harnesses. They are not user configuration and are unsupported for installed packages.

| Prefix or variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ENSEMBLE_LIVE_*` | Live-suite selection, expectations, timeouts, artifacts, and TUI size. |
| `ENSEMBLE_LATENCY_*` | Latency probe profile, samples, server, workspace, and output. |
| `ENSEMBLE_PROBE_*` | Host-probe artifacts, output, validation, and write controls. |
| `ENSEMBLE_FAKE_*` | Deterministic fake-host delays, handoff directory, and initial timing. |
| `ENSEMBLE_SOAK_*` | Soak duration, agents, workspaces, burst, sample interval, RSS ceilings, and output. |
| `ENSEMBLE_V6_*` | Legacy size-matrix selection and load-skip controls. |
| `ENSEMBLE_SUBAGENT_EXPECT` | Expected native-subagent behavior for the live probe. |
| `ENSEMBLE_HOST_PROBE_EVENTS` | Host-probe event capture selection. |
| `ENSEMBLE_NATIVE_HOST_FIXTURE` | Module path for the native-host fixture test. |
| `OPENCODE_BIN`, `TMUX_BIN`, `NODE_BIN` | Explicit executables for the live harness. |
